topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and frames the importance and complexity of studying the complement system.

topics.label: Overview and Functions of the Complement System
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the general three-step framework and physiological functions of complement in pathogen defense and clearance.

topics.label: Complement Nomenclature and Numbering Conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the historical rules and exceptions governing complement component naming and cleavage fragments.

topics.label: Central Role and Chemical Reactivity of C3
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the pivotal role of C3 cleavage and thioester bond reactivity as the central fulcrum of complement activation.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways and Trigger Threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways through which pathogen recognition triggers concentrated C3 deposition.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Activated Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream processes of opsonization, inflammation, and membrane attack complex lysis that eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical Consequences of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct clinical presentations and disease phenotypes caused by deficiencies in specific complement components and regulators.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement Defenses
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the evolutionary strategies and molecular mechanisms used by pathogens to evade complement clearance.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture on complement and previews the upcoming topic on adaptive immunity.
